name: landing-blog-article
context: Design a blog post article layout for a marketing or company website. The audience is readers consuming long-form content including text, images, code snippets, and embedded media. Target platforms: desktop and mobile responsive. Must prioritize readability with optimal line length and vertical rhythm.
constraints: All visual values must reference Design_Token (no raw hex, px, or rem values)
Follow typography.rules.json for article heading hierarchy (h1-h4) and body prose
Apply color.rules.json for link styling, code block backgrounds, and blockquotes
Use layout.rules.json max-width constraint for readable content column (65-75ch)
Images must include alt text and responsive srcset considerations
Code blocks must use monospace font token with proper contrast
Article structure must use semantic HTML heading hierarchy

outputCriteria.format: Article page layout spec with content blocks, typography hierarchy, and reading metrics
qualityChecks: Typography follows defined scale ratio with proper vertical rhythm
Content column width constrains to readable line length
Heading hierarchy is sequential without skipping levels
Code blocks maintain contrast and use monospace tokens
accessibilityRequirements: Heading hierarchy is sequential (h1 > h2 > h3)
Links are distinguishable by more than color alone
Reading time and metadata accessible to screen readers

examples.description: Article header with title, metadata, and featured image
examples.output:
Organism: ArticleHeader
  Layout: flex(direction: column, gap: var(--space-lg))
  max-width: var(--content-max-width)
  margin: 0 auto
  padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-md)
  Children:
    - Molecule: ArticleMeta
        - Atom: Badge(label=category, variant=subtle)
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary, content='reading-time')
    - Atom: Text(role=h1, token=typography.heading.xl, color=color.text.primary)
    - Molecule: AuthorRow(layout=flex, gap=var(--space-sm), align=center)
        - Atom: Avatar(size=sm)
        - Atom: Text(token=typography.body.sm, color=color.text.secondary)
    - Atom: Image(width=full, radius=var(--radius-lg), alt=featured-description)
acceptanceCriteria: Uses semantic tokens for all values
Heading uses largest scale token for article title
Metadata is secondary in visual hierarchy
Featured image has rounded corners and alt text
